name: 200–400-Milligram Evening Magnesium
title: Test 200 to 400 milligrams of magnesium in the evening.
benefit: Possibly deeper and more restful sleep.
subtitle: Sleep Supplement
rationale: Magnesium is cheap and low-risk enough to test directly against your own sleep data over a couple of weeks.

evidence.summary: Small trials, mostly in older or deficient adults, report modest improvements in insomnia measures; evidence in healthy adults is thin.

indications: Sleep quality lags despite solid behavior-level hygiene.
Dietary magnesium intake is likely low.
No sleep supplement has been trialled one at a time.
avoidWhen: Kidney disease or impaired renal function unless cleared by a physician.
